coverage: title + tagline + job relevance + 8 outcomes + 8 theory code/output blocks + 9 callouts + 2 figures

top_level.current_content: Endpoints de IA, Hugging Face y prompting evaluado
top_level.justification: Matches roadmap ownership and accurately names the intended domain.

top_level.current_content: clasificador/extractor especializado y generador de narrativa con JSON validado; no se acepta una salida sin evidencia ni eval contra baseline
top_level.improved_content: Compara baseline, clasificador/extractor y generador estructurado sobre el mismo golden versionado; cada salida queda ligada a evidencia válida, modelo/revisión y schema tipado antes de revisión humana.
top_level.justification: Current theory has only mocks/dict builders, no specialized extractor/model-generated narrative, no full schema grounding and no executable baseline comparison.

top_level.current_content: En un desk de riesgos u operaciones en Lima (bancos, fintech, back-office de retail), el analista ya tiene campos OCR y necesita un asistente de IA que clasifique o redacte borradores sin inventar ni autoetiquetar fraude. Aquí aprendes a unificar un endpoint HTTP local o un transformers.pipeline bajo el mismo contrato de salida, validar el JSON y evaluar con golden sets (conjuntos de referencia con respuesta conocida). El score del modelo es señal de prioridad para revisión humana, nunca veredicto legal ni de parentesco.
top_level.improved_content: En un desk de riesgos u operaciones, la IA recibe evidencia candidata del intake, no hechos garantizados. El objetivo es normalizar un adaptador local y uno HTTP al mismo contrato versionado, validar forma y grounding contra la evidencia del run, comparar candidato y baseline en un golden fijo y enviar las salidas no verificadas a revisión humana. El score puede priorizar revisión; nunca decide fraude, parentesco ni otra adjudicación sensible.
top_level.justification: Restores upstream trust boundary and makes adapter/baseline evidence explicit.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Elegir regla vs. modelo especializado vs. LLM con justificación auditable
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Generar candidatos regla/modelo especializado/LLM y elegirlos mediante comparación auditable contra el mismo baseline, golden y restricciones operativas.
learning_outcomes.justification: Selection cannot rest on a universal 500-example threshold.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Leer model cards, licencias y decidir despliegue local o cloud
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Convertir model card/licencia/política de datos en un registro de gobierno trazable y decidir local/cloud con uso permitido, revisión del modelo, proveedor y controles de datos explícitos.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current deploy_choice does not enforce intended/out-of-scope use and does not bind model/card revision.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Implementar un adapter mock de pipeline/endpoint con contrato estable
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Implementar mocks deterministas y demostrar el mismo contract test contra al menos un adaptador real controlado, validando cardinalidad, tipos, labels, score y revisión del modelo.
learning_outcomes.justification: Mock-only competence does not earn endpoint/pipeline equivalence.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Operar batching, timeout, caché, costo y fallback (con circuit breaker simple)
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Operar batches y timeouts reales del cliente, caché por identidad completa, costo con unidad/precio versionados y circuit breaker por dependencia con recovery, alerta y fallback ejecutable.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current code simulates timeout, mis-models cost/cache and has a permanently-open global circuit.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Diseñar prompts con objetivo, contexto, restricciones, ejemplos y schema JSON
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Diseñar prompts estructurados cuyo output use un schema único tipado, no invente unidades/valores y valide cada evidence_id y número contra el contexto canónico.
learning_outcomes.justification: Canonical prompt output currently violates its own narrative contract and invents PEN.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Controlar thinking, tools y checkpoints con allowlist y stop en denegación
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Controlar esfuerzo de razonamiento cuando exista y herramientas mediante autorización de nombre+argumentos+recurso, ejecución acotada, validación de resultado y checkpoints observables; deny=stop.
learning_outcomes.justification: Name-only allowlisting and synthetic think logs are not sufficient tool governance.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Evaluar con golden set: exact match, tasa de acierto por campo y schema rate + revisión humana
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Evaluar candidato y baseline sobre el mismo golden versionado con presencia+valor por campo, schema tipado, denominadores explícitos y review records antes de promoción.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current metric has missing-vs-null false positives, n=0 crash and no baseline/review implementation.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Mitigar injection y exfiltración minimizando payload y privilegios; documentar límites de sesgo en la model card
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Tratar input externo como no confiable, minimizar datos/privilegios y hacer cumplir output/action validation y aprobación; añadir regression guard contra adjudicación automática y documentar cobertura/sesgo sin fingir métricas no calculadas.
learning_outcomes.justification: Canonical injection signal does not stop the request and approval/no-autofraud remain metadata/prose only.

current_content.title: choose_stack.py

code_output_blocks.improved_content: Make this a candidate-generator, label 500 as fixture-only, then require same-golden baseline comparison and immutable model metadata before final selection.
code_output_blocks.justification: The code currently converts a toy heuristic into an architecture decision.

current_content.title: model_card.py
current_content.code: card={name,license,intended,not_for,pii_training}; deploy_choice(card,has_pii_live) checks only has_pii_live and license; blocked_use is printed separately

code_output_blocks.improved_content: Normalize source card evidence into a local governance record and make one deployment_policy enforce out-of-scope/intended use, license/legal review, data class/provider controls and immutable model/card revision.
code_output_blocks.justification: A prohibited-use card can currently receive a positive deployment choice.

current_content.title: hf_mock.py
current_content.code: mock_pipeline loops texts; keyword 'factura' => billing/0.9 else other/0.6; returns {model,label,score}

code_output_blocks.improved_content: Retain this stub for unit tests, add a typed contract validator and run the same tests against a controlled transformers/HTTP adapter carrying trust and immutable model metadata.
code_output_blocks.justification: A keyword rule cannot demonstrate real HF/endpoint equivalence or specialized-model failure modes.

current_content.title: ops_infer.py
current_content.code: cache key sha256(model|text)[:12]; cost from len(text); one global failures counter opens at 3; fail=True raises TimeoutError; open returns rules_or_human
current_content.output: first result; cached hit; failures 3 then circuit open

code_output_blocks.improved_content: Use configured client timeout, full canonical inference cache identity, actual billed units, breaker state per dependency with half-open recovery/alerts, and typed fallback decisions consumed by real routes.
code_output_blocks.justification: The current operational mock has stale-cache, fake-cost and permanent-open failure modes.

current_content.title: prompt_struct.py
current_content.code: PROMPT context says mediana Lima=28 n=40; required output keys hallazgo,n,mediana,limite; build_output returns dict; output hallazgo says 'Mediana Lima 28 PEN'

code_output_blocks.improved_content: Use the canonical narrative schema including evidence_ids/model, pass unit explicitly from trusted context, preserve monetary semantics, validate types and reconcile every claim/evidence id before review.
code_output_blocks.justification: This is the strongest self-contradiction: the no-invention example invents PEN and omits evidence/model.

current_content.title: tools_check.py
current_content.code: ALLOW_TOOLS={calc_sum,lookup_metric}; run_checkpointed logs think; allowed tool => {'tool':name,'ok':True}; denied name stops
current_content.output: think log, calc_sum ok, shell_rm tool_denied

code_output_blocks.improved_content: Log plan summaries rather than hidden reasoning; authorize typed tool args/resource/side effects, execute in adapter, validate result, and only then mark success/narrate. Add optional GLM-5.2 mapping or update roadmap.
code_output_blocks.justification: The current code marks success without execution and does not implement validate/narrate checkpoints.

current_content.title: golden_ai.py
current_content.code: schema_ok checks required key presence; field_match_rate unions keys and compares pred.get==gold.get; eval_rows divides by len(rows)

code_output_blocks.improved_content: Validate typed schema, score key presence separately from value, return not_evaluable for n=0, and compare versioned candidate+baseline on the identical golden with promotion criteria.
code_output_blocks.justification: Missing prediction vs gold null currently scores as correct and no baseline is executed.

current_content.title: secure_prompt.py
current_content.code: injection_signal regex; build_request always returns system+untrusted_document+allowed_tools=[]+requires_human_approval=True; minimize allowlists keys

code_output_blocks.improved_content: Keep regex as telemetry but make policy routing consume the signal; enforce output/action authorization outside the model, bind human approval to exact action/output, and add a no-autofraud contract test.
code_output_blocks.justification: The canonical malicious fixture is detected yet still packaged for model processing, and approval is only a boolean.

callouts.current_content: Sin PII real a endpoints públicos. schema_fail o indicios de injection → human_review. Score ≠ fraude. Fixture CASO-LIM-025. Mismo test de contrato para mock HTTP y mock HF dentro de cada forma de salida.
callouts.justification: Good normative rule; executable routing must be repaired to comply.

callouts.current_content: Ningún stack etiqueta fraude o parentesco solo; genera evidencia para revisión humana.
callouts.justification: Correct safety boundary; add regression test rather than rewriting the statement.

callouts.current_content: Apache-2.0 no te autoriza a usar el modelo fuera del intended use sensible ni a saltarte not_for.
callouts.improved_content: Una licencia permisiva no sustituye la revisión de uso previsto, usos fuera de alcance, políticas y obligaciones aplicables. En el lab, `not_for` es una normalización local de esa documentación.
callouts.justification: Avoids implying not_for is a universal card field or that model-card text itself is license law.

callouts.current_content: En prod reemplaza el mock por pipeline o endpoint real con el mismo contrato de salida y los mismos tests.
callouts.improved_content: Conserva el mock para unit tests, pero antes de dar por cumplida la sección ejecuta el mismo contract test contra un adaptador real controlado y registra su model revision/config.
callouts.justification: Makes the missing bridge an explicit gate instead of a future suggestion.

callouts.current_content: Reprocesar sin caché multiplica la factura en la nube; un circuito abierto sin alerta es un apagón silencioso.
callouts.justification: Correct statement; current code simply fails to implement the alert/recovery it describes.

callouts.current_content: Si el JSON no valida, la salida se descarta aunque el texto “se vea bien”.
callouts.justification: Correct fail-closed principle; strengthen what validation means in code.

callouts.current_content: Un tool de red o filesystem sin sandbox es un incidente esperando ocurrir. Checkpoint: plan → tool → validar → narrar; deny = stop.
callouts.improved_content: Una herramienta con red/archivos requiere sandbox, argumentos y recursos autorizados y una política de side effects. Checkpoint: plan → autorizar → ejecutar → validar resultado → narrar; cualquier deny o validación fallida = stop.
callouts.justification: Name allowlisting alone is not a sufficient privilege boundary.

callouts.current_content: Gate CP-N2-C: no se acepta salida sin evidencia ni eval vs. baseline.
callouts.justification: This is the correct gate; candidate code must be changed to prove it.

callouts.current_content: OCR y emails son untrusted: se delimitan como datos, sin herramientas ni secretos. Detectar una frase no vuelve seguro el contenido.
callouts.justification: Strong security framing aligned with OWASP; executable action/output enforcement is missing.
